text: Why study in DUFE 1.Brought up a huge number of international students from over 100 countries. 2.Located in west of Xinghai Park in Dalian city, which is a famous national scenic site. 3.DUFE emphasizes a students-centered educational approach. 4.Good climate with distinctively four seasons. 5.Convenient traffic. 6.A nationally designated Business Chinese Test center and a test center for the Chinese 7. Proficiency Test(HSK) Program Introduction Hospitality and tourism management degrees are administered by the Global Institute of Management & Economics (GIME). If you are a talented student graduating from an undergraduate course who is seeking a career in hospitality and tourism, this programme offers you an affordable study option in terms of tuition and living costs – with full access to world-class university facilities. Teaching Objective To integrate humanistic spirit and professional knowledge into university education, to train graduates with global competitiveness and with international perspectives, and to provide intellectual resources and support for management practice for the industry. Main Courses Brief Introduction of Tourism, Tourism Economics, Hotel Management Principle, Tourism Resources and Their Development, etc. Fee Structure Tuition fee: 58500RMB/year Duration 2.5 Years Degree Awarded Master's Degree Future Career This program includes theoretical, empirical and practical components to prepare candidates to work in public and private tourism and tourism related enterprises after graduation. Teaching Facilities The learning and teaching methods are a combination of lectures, seminars, tutorials, study tours and project-based assignments. Teacher Highlight Over 85% of the faculty lecturers are qualified with doctoral degrees
